entries.label: Hairline Screen Crack
entries.description: A thin crack on the phone screen that does not affect normal display functionality.

entries.label: Corner Screen Crack
entries.description: A crack located at one corner of the phone screen.

entries.label: Top Edge Crack
entries.description: A crack beginning from the top edge of the phone screen.

entries.label: Bottom Edge Crack
entries.description: A crack beginning from the bottom edge of the phone screen.

entries.label: Left Edge Crack
entries.description: A crack beginning from the left edge of the display.

entries.label: Right Edge Crack
entries.description: A crack beginning from the right edge of the display.

entries.label: Vertical Screen Crack
entries.description: A crack running vertically across the phone display.

entries.label: Horizontal Screen Crack
entries.description: A crack running horizontally across the phone display.

entries.label: Diagonal Screen Crack
entries.description: A crack running diagonally across the phone screen.

entries.label: Multiple Screen Cracks
entries.description: More than one visible crack appears on the phone screen.

entries.label: Spider-Web Crack
entries.description: Cracks spread outward from a single impact point in a spider-web pattern.

entries.label: Shattered Screen
entries.description: The screen glass is heavily broken with extensive visible cracks.
entries.notes: A shattered screen is always considered a high-severity defect.

entries.label: Deep Screen Crack
entries.description: A deep crack that penetrates the screen glass and may affect usability.

entries.label: Surface Glass Crack
entries.description: A crack affecting only the outer glass surface.

entries.label: LCD/OLED Internal Crack
entries.description: A crack affecting the internal display panel.
entries.notes: Internal display damage is always treated as high severity.

entries.label: Back Glass Crack
entries.description: A visible crack on the rear glass panel of the phone.

entries.label: Camera Lens Crack
entries.description: A crack on the protective camera lens.

entries.label: Frame Crack
entries.description: A structural crack in the phone frame.

entries.label: Screen Separation
entries.description: The screen is separating from the phone body after impact.
entries.notes: Screen separation indicates severe structural damage.

entries.label: No Defect Detected
entries.description: No visible cracks or structural damage were found.

confidence_escalation_note: Predictions below the confidence threshold should be reviewed manually.
